== Summary ==
A player in a brown "MAN the GUNS!" / "Join the Rebellion" tee at the [[2025 European Championship]] at Zu den Vier Winden in Bochum (19–21 September 2025). The same person appears in [[:File:2025 European Championship 16.jpg]], [[:File:2025 European Championship 17.jpg]], and as the right-hand player in [[:File:2025 European Championship team event 3.jpg]] (so he is not [[Casper Jørgensen]], who is the mid player in that still).

A player with his cards at the [[2025 European Championship]] at Zu den Vier Winden in Bochum (19–21 September 2025).
